items.statement: Students at schools with five or more licensed retailers within 800 metres (road network) will have higher odds of current smoking than students at schools with none, after adjustment for school socioeconomic status, neighbourhood deprivation and remoteness.
items.rationale: Directly answers the minister's question with the evidence's main conflict built in.
items.risks: Residual confounding; the adjusted estimate may be null, which is also informative.

items.statement: The association with current vaping will be at least as strong as with smoking.
items.rationale: Vapes are now the main product students use.
